description: Propose a look from the person's own website without saving anything: give url (their site) or tokens (the text of a W3C Design Tokens .tokens.json file). Returns six page colors read from the site and fixed to meet the contrast floors, heading and body fonts (ours by the same family name, else the nearest of ours with substitute: true and the site's own family name), button corner shape, and the site's logo as a candidate picture. Try it with bio_design_preview (kit's colors, fonts and buttons as the design), then save kit with brand_kit_set (pages that follow the brand pick it up, locks and Undo apply). To use the logo, media_import_url its logo_url first, then pass the ready id as logo_media_id.

tokens.description: The text of a .tokens.json file (Design Tokens Community Group format): color and fontFamily tokens

url.description: Their site, like example.com or https://example.com. Public https only

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: brand_look_from_site
title: Match my site
